Section(s): An improved model including glucose and fructose enables the prediction of cell growth at low sucrose concentrations

Text and equations in reading order:
    Time trajectories of measured and predicted data (continuous line) for the initial model validation representing the cultivation of BY-2 cells under optimal (experiments #4 and #5) and non-optimal (experiments #6 and #7) conditions (A–D) Iteration 2. Measurement uncertainty made of a constant and proportional component (Table S4). A, ammonium; F, fructose; G, glucose; N, nitrate; P, phosphate; S, sucrose; V, volume; X, cell dry mass. See Table S3 for measured initial values.
(18) \begin{aligned}\mu=&\left(\mu_{m}+\mu_{m}^{A}\frac{A}{A+\delta_{A}}+\mu_{m}^{P}\frac{P}{P+\delta_{P}}\right)\\&\left(\frac{G}{G+K_{G}}\frac{K_{IG}}{G+K_{IG}}+\frac{F}{F+K_{F}}\frac{K_{IF}}{F+K_{IF}}\right)\left(\frac{N}{N+K_{N}}\frac{K_{IN}}{N+K_{IN}}\right)\end{aligned}    [code: algebraic, computes \mu, code proposes constitutive]

Symbols:
  \mu: μ is the specific growth rate. [h^{-1}] (computed)
  \mu_{m}: Maximum specific growth rate [h^{-1}] (parameter)
  \mu_{m}^{A}: maximum specific growth rate for ammonium [h^{-1}] (parameter)
  A: Concentration of nutrients (sucrose, ammonium, nitrate, phosphate) in the reactor [g L^{-1}] (computed)
  \delta_{A}: Minimal ammonium concentration in the medium at which cell growth occurs (parameter)
  \mu_{m}^{P}: Maximum specific growth rate contribution from phosphate [h^-1] (parameter)
  P: phosphate concentration (computed)
  \delta_{P}: Minimal phosphate concentration in the medium at which cell growth occurs (parameter)
  G: Glucose concentration (computed)
  K_{G}: Monod saturation constant for glucose (parameter)
  K_{IG}: Glucose inhibition constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  F: Fructose concentration (computed)
  K_{F}: Fructose saturation constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{IF}: Fructose inhibition constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  N: Nitrate concentration [g L^{-1}] (computed)
  K_{N}: Nitrate saturation constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)
  K_{IN}: Nitrate inhibition constant [g L^{-1}] (parameter)

Model-wide assumptions (already recorded, do not repeat):
  - The model assumes an irreversible progression in which active cells (active DM) are converted into dead cells (dead DM).

Laws: 18

laws.description: Specific growth rate μ expressed as the product of a baseline maximum rate and contributions from ammonium and phosphate, multiplied by combined Monod-type saturation and inhibition terms for glucose, fructose, and nitrate.
laws.law_type_reason: It defines μ as a kinetic expression based on substrate saturation and inhibition.
